scope: Printed headers, hierarchy, printed column numbers and physical row geometry only. Charlotta17 and Arne18 are name locators; Karl16 boundary anchor only. No data-cell or blank-cell conclusions.
independence: No old transcription or root stage1 result read. Original media only; no other source passage.

Yrke (tjänst, näringsfång); Stam (främmande); Lyte (sinnessjukdom, sinnesslöhet, blindhet, dövstumhet, fallandesot).

Anteckning om minderårigs föräldrar; omyndigförklaring; äktenskapsbetyg, äktenskapscertifikat och lysning; avtal om barns uppfostran i viss troslära; frånvaro; utträde ur eller inträde i svenska kyrkan; främmande trosbekännelse eller nationalitet; på grund av ådömd straffpåföljd utestängda från behörighet och rättigheter, som omförmälas i 2 kap. 19 § strafflagen; nattvardshinder; uttaget flyttningsbetyg; m. m.

geometry.coordinate_system: Original image pixels, origin upper-left. Bounds approximate, typically ±10 pixels; vertical rules drift relative to header. They are guides, not a finite accepted cell mask.
geometry.printed_numbering: 1–10 on left leaf; 11–18 on right leaf. 18 is physically printed over Död.
geometry.row_pitch_px: Approximately 128–130. Dotted lines are writing baselines below printed row-number centres, not row centres or upper/lower cell walls.
geometry.slant: Across the left leaf each dotted baseline rises roughly 17–20 pixels from outer to inner edge. Right-leaf baseline is comparatively level with small local curvature.
geometry.ink_geometry: Ink can extend well above and below row-number centres and baseline-derived strips. Target geometry crop includes all three rows for spatial context. In particular the large col14 target ink reaches upwards into the band between the row17 and row18 baselines; a fixed midpoint band would risk clipping it. No content of that ink is read here. Cross-outs are not row boundaries.
geometry.mask_status: No finite per-cell mask accepted at stage1; later mask must follow ink extents and row association, not a uniform rectangle.

inspection_limits: The first wide header crop included incidental rows1–5; the initial geometry locator strips included row-number context14–20 and narrow incidental data edges. Those data were not transcribed or assessed. Tighter header and target crops were subsequently generated.
Target whole-row crop was viewed exclusively for rules, slant and ink extent. Existing named fields, address, death, marriage and military contents were not newly transcribed or reassessed.
No positive or blank cell assertions; no canonical, Wotan or archive changes.
